builtInStudyReview: Reviewed all six ENTRIES studies and existing evidence. The Colossian-network study shares Colossians 4:8 and 4:16 but concerns social links and circulating letters; these proposals concern an edition difference and an unanswered letter identity, so they are separately scoped.
interpretationLimits: Edition-specific limits retained; neither Greek edition is treated as a critical apparatus or proof of the original reading. Annotation presence is not exhaustive review.
